fusions.name: Hasty Foolscap
fusions.desc: Flicks a loose leaf into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Scattered Sheaf
fusions.desc: Startles a sheaf of pages into flight around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Quick Exit
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Errata Slip
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
